name: Valguero
summary: Valguero is a free, official, non-canonical DLC expansion map for ARK: Survival Evolved and ARK: Survival Ascended.
features: Freezing air in the snow desert.
An underground ocean called The Abyss.
Ichthyosaurus and Carbonemys corpses scattered along the lake.
Mushrooms on the emerald forest that can be harvested for Rare Flower, Rare Mushroom and Bio Toxin.
Deinonychus nests on the The Paradise, Chalk Hills.
An ice and volcanic Wyvern Trench, to get Fire Wyvern Eggs and Ice Wyvern Eggs.
